# DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.7 migration fixture

`fixture.json` is generated by the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7`
runtime. It contains one workspace and one durable session with a title, Plan
mode, a `read-only` permission selection, and a completed `todo_write` tool
call. The generator uses a deterministic loopback-only model endpoint, so it
does not contact an external model service. The fixture contains no API key or
other credential.

To regenerate it, install the legacy runtime under
`.cache/legacy-runtime/node_modules`, verify that its package version is
`0.1.0-rc.7`, and run:

```powershell
node scripts/generate-legacy-dsh-fixture.cjs
```

The generator refuses any other source version and rejects output that looks
like it contains credentials or generator-local paths. It replaces durable
workspace, legacy-runtime, and loopback-origin strings with `$WORKSPACE`,
`$LEGACY_RUNTIME`, and `$LOOPBACK_ORIGIN` tokens. The migration smoke replaces
`$WORKSPACE` wherever it appears with its temporary absolute path and recreates
the official concatenated Zstandard frame layout before starting the current
Harness.
